dataclass AgentApplication
  program: str
  title: str
dataclass ChatBinding
  chat_id: str
  chat_title: str
  source_instance: str
  launch: ChatLaunch | None
dataclass ChatInboxChange
  outcome: Outcome | None
  context: str
  revision: str
  holder: str
  opened_unix_ms: int
dataclass ChatLaunch
  session: str
  origin: ChatOrigin | str
  cwd: str
  mode: ChatMode | str
enum ChatMode
  PLAN = 'plan'
  READ_ONLY = 'read_only'
  DEFAULT = 'default'
  ACCEPT_EDITS = 'accept_edits'
enum ChatOrigin
  DESKTOP = 'desktop'
  CLI = 'cli'
dataclass ChatSendRequest
  request: SendRequest
  return_context: str
enum Delivery
  QUEUED = 'queued'
  DELIVERED = 'delivered'
  UNDELIVERED = 'undelivered'
enum DeliveryObservationOutcome
  OBSERVED = 'observed'
  UNKNOWN = 'unknown'
  INVALID = 'invalid'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'
class DispatchError(ValueError)
  __init__(code)
dataclass Header
  message_id: str
  from_: str
  from_context: str
  to: str
  context: str
  kind: Kind | None
  subject: str
  context_id: str
  expires_unix_ms: int
  reply_to: str
  answer_by_unix_ms: int
  task_state: TaskState | None
  refused: bool
  reference: MessageRef | None
  remote_origin: RemoteOrigin | None
  reply_reference: MessageRef | None
  delivery: Delivery | None
  undelivered: UndeliveredReason | None
  count: int | None
dataclass Inbox
  program: str
  context: str
  status: str
  revision: str
  watching: bool
  last_seen_unix_ms: int
  reach: InboxReach | None
  chat_title: str
  mine: bool | None
dataclass InboxChange
  outcome: Outcome | None
  revision: str
  holder: str
  opened_unix_ms: int
dataclass InboxPage
  outcome: Outcome | None
  cursor: str
  inboxes: list[Inbox]
  reason: str
  needs_permission: list[AgentApplication]
  other_chats: list[ProgramChats]
dataclass InboxQuery
  cursor: str
  peer_key: str
  pairing_epoch: str
  receiver: str
enum InboxReach
  OPEN = 'open'
  QUEUED = 'queued'
  STARTS_ON_QUESTION = 'starts_on_question'
enum Kind
  NOTE = 'note'
  QUESTION = 'question'
  REPLY = 'reply'
dataclass Message
  header: Header
  idempotency_key: str
  body: str
dataclass MessageRef
  owner_peer_key: str
  message_id: str
class Messages
  observe_delivery(reference: MessageRef, pairing_epoch: str) -> ObserveDeliveryResult
  inboxes_for_person(cursor: str) -> InboxPage
  inbox_open_chat(instance: str, source_context: str, status: str, binding: ChatBinding) -> ChatInboxChange
  send_chat(instance: str, source_context: str, request: ChatSendRequest) -> SendResult
  prepare(instance: str, source_context: str, request: PrepareRequest) -> PrepareResult
  reply(instance: str, source_context: str, message_id: str, body: str) -> SendResult
  inbox_open(instance: str, context: str, status: str) -> InboxChange
  inboxes_list(query: InboxQuery) -> InboxPage
  send(instance: str, source_context: str, request: SendRequest) -> SendResult
  wait(instance: str, context: str, view: View | None, after: str, revision: str, wait_ms: int) -> Page
  read_for_person(message_id: str) -> Page
  stop_for_person(message_id: str) -> StopResult
  turn_wake(instance: str, source_context: str, wake: str) -> TurnWakeResult
class MessagesClient(Messages)
  __init__(transport)
  observe_delivery(reference: MessageRef, pairing_epoch: str) -> ObserveDeliveryResult
  inboxes_for_person(cursor: str) -> InboxPage
  inbox_open_chat(instance: str, source_context: str, status: str, binding: ChatBinding) -> ChatInboxChange
  send_chat(instance: str, source_context: str, request: ChatSendRequest) -> SendResult
  prepare(instance: str, source_context: str, request: PrepareRequest) -> PrepareResult
  reply(instance: str, source_context: str, message_id: str, body: str) -> SendResult
  inbox_open(instance: str, context: str, status: str) -> InboxChange
  inboxes_list(query: InboxQuery) -> InboxPage
  send(instance: str, source_context: str, request: SendRequest) -> SendResult
  wait(instance: str, context: str, view: View | None, after: str, revision: str, wait_ms: int) -> Page
  read_for_person(message_id: str) -> Page
  stop_for_person(message_id: str) -> StopResult
  turn_wake(instance: str, source_context: str, wake: str) -> TurnWakeResult
dataclass ObserveDeliveryResult
  outcome: DeliveryObservationOutcome | None
  delivery: Delivery | None
  undelivered: UndeliveredReason | None
dataclass OriginClaim
  namespace: str
  application: str
  program_label: str
  return_context: str
enum Outcome
  SENT = 'sent'
  OPENED = 'opened'
  HELD = 'held'
  PAGE = 'page'
  GAP = 'gap'
  CONFLICT = 'conflict'
  FORBIDDEN = 'forbidden'
  INVALID = 'invalid'
  EXHAUSTED = 'exhausted'
  UNAVAILABLE = 'unavailable'
  UNKNOWN = 'unknown'
  ENDED = 'ended'
dataclass Page
  outcome: Outcome | None
  cursor: str
  revision: str
  messages: list[Message]
  headers: list[Header]
  pending_until_unix_ms: int
  reply_until_unix_ms: int
  wake: str
  unread: int | None
  pending_questions: int | None
  oldest_unread_unix_ms: int | None
  newest_unread_unix_ms: int | None
  awaited_replies: int | None
  oldest_wake: str
dataclass PrepareRequest
  receiver: str
  body: str
  context: str
  kind: Kind | None
  subject: str
  ttl_ms: int
  answer_within_ms: int
  context_title: str

  send_request: SendRequest | None
  reason: str
  choices: list[Inbox]
  chat_title: str
dataclass ProgramChats
  program: str
  chats: int
class Refusal(ValueError)
  __init__(word, offset)
dataclass RemoteOrigin
  peer_key: str
  claim: OriginClaim
dataclass SendRequest

  context: str
  kind: Kind | None
  subject: str
  body: str
  idempotency_key: str

  withdraw: str
  answer_by_unix_ms: int

  reply_reference: MessageRef | None
  withdraw_reference: MessageRef | None
  pairing_epoch: str
  notify_delivered: bool | None

  message_id: str
  context_id: str
  receiver_watching: bool
  awaiting_permission: bool
  retry_after_ms: int
  reference: MessageRef | None
  reason: str
  refused: bool
  refusal: _dependency_rights.RefusalDetail | None
  context: str
  chat_title: str
class ServiceError(Exception)
  __init__(code, message)
enum ServiceErrorCode
  HANDLER_ERROR = 'handler_error'
  INVALID_RESULT = 'invalid_result'
  UNKNOWN_VERSION = 'unknown_version'
  UNKNOWN_SERVICE = 'unknown_service'
  UNKNOWN_METHOD = 'unknown_method'
  WRONG_MODE = 'wrong_mode'
dataclass StopResult
  outcome: Outcome | None
  reason: str
enum TaskState
  SUBMITTED = 'submitted'
  COMPLETED = 'completed'
  CANCELED = 'canceled'
  FAILED = 'failed'
  AUTH_REQUIRED = 'auth_required'
  REJECTED = 'rejected'
dataclass TurnWakeResult

  reason: str
enum UndeliveredReason

  REFUSED = 'refused'
  CONTEXT_CLOSED = 'context_closed'
  RECEIVER_REMOVED = 'receiver_removed'
  PEER_REMOVED = 'peer_removed'
  LOST = 'lost'
  UNCONFIRMED = 'unconfirmed'
enum View
  BODY = 'body'
  HEADERS = 'headers'
